source_text.body:
Have an AI agent shop for a gift on a $25 budget
The author gave an agent a virtual debit card to buy a gift; it browsed, compared products and reached checkout but struggled with CAPTCHAs, dynamic pricing and bot-blocking stores.
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
Pawel Jozefiak gave his AI agent $25 on a virtual debit card and told it to buy a gift. The agent browsed stores, compared products and worked its way to checkout without help. The page I could read is only a short summary, so it doesn't describe the tooling or any manual steps.
How it went
The agent got as far as checkout but failed at the last mile: CAPTCHAs, dynamic pricing, and stores that block automated browsers. The summary doesn't say whether a purchase went through.
Worth knowing
Expect authentication, anti-bot checks and payment confirmation to be where an agent gets stuck, so plan to handle those steps yourself.
Try it yourself
with
ChatGPT Agent
Copy prompt
Find a gift for [recipient, with their interests] under $[25] total including shipping and tax. Browse a few stores, compare at least [3] options on price, reviews and delivery time, and recommend one with reasons. Take it to the checkout page but stop before entering payment details or placing the order, and show me the item, final price and shipping address for approval. If a store blocks you or shows a CAPTCHA, skip it and tell me which one.
Original source: https://wiz.jock.pl/articles/ai-agent-shopping-experiment-real-money-2026/
